headline: New York Times in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
summary: The New York Times Company is reportedly in talks to acquire the film-focused social network Letterboxd for around $330 million, after Sony Pictures Entertainment and A24 were also previously rumored to be interested. Letterboxd has grown dramatically in recent years.
